overclaims.statement: Irene Tracey is the Warden (Head) of Merton College, Oxford University
overclaims.citedQuote: Warden (Head) of Merton College, Oxford University; 2019-10–present or unstated
overclaims.rationale: The ORCID self-report gives '2019-10–present or unstated', but multiple retained sources establish she was installed as Warden on 5 October 2019 and served only until the start of her Vice-Chancellorship in 2023 (and is elsewhere described in this same dossier as 'former Warden of Merton College'). Asserting the wardenship in the present tense is a past role stated as current.

overclaims.statement: Irene Tracey is Pro-Vice Chancellor at University of Oxford
overclaims.citedQuote: University of Oxford — Pro-Vice Chancellor, University of Oxford; 2018–present or unstated
overclaims.rationale: The only support is an ORCID self-report marked '2018–present or unstated'. She became Vice-Chancellor in 2023, so the Pro-Vice-Chancellor role cannot be current; the dossier asserts it in the present tense from a stale self-reported record.

The source is a podcast feed description from the period before her 5 October 2019 installation. 'Warden-elect' was a transient pre-2019 status; presenting it as a career claim without dating implies a current state that ended years ago.

overclaims.statement: Nuffield Chair of Anaesthetic Science and Head of the Nuffield Department of Clinical Neuroscience at the University of Oxford
overclaims.citedQuote: Professor Irene Tracey, Nuffield Chair of Anaesthetic Science and Head of the Nuffield Department of Clinical Neuroscience at the University of Oxford
overclaims.rationale: The cited passage comes from the same pre-October-2019 podcast description (it also calls her 'Warden-elect'). She became Head of the department in October 2016 and Vice-Chancellor in 2023; presenting the department-head role as a current career position is a past role stated as current. Whether the chair title itself persists is not established by this passage.

overclaims.statement: Professor Irene Tracey, Nuffield Chair of Anaesthetic Science and Head of the Nuffield Department of Clinical Neuroscience at the University of Oxford, and Warden-elect of Merton College

usefulness.rationale: The dossier gives a clear, well-corroborated picture of Irene Tracey: British neuroscientist (b. 1966, Oxford), Vice-Chancellor of the University of Oxford since 2023, former Warden of Merton College (2019–2023), Professor of Anaesthetic Neuroscience, co-founder/director of FMRIB, pain-neuroscience researcher, CBE and FRS, with documented public positions on EDI and free speech. Multiple independent source families (Wikipedia, Oxford podcasts, Oxford AWiSE, Crossref/DataCite records, news) agree on the core facts, and the dossier correctly marks participation-only limits on publication records. It loses a point on remainingQuestions because it flags contested/claimed statuses but never explicitly states what it does not know (e.g., whether she still holds the Nuffield Chair, the unresolved Pro-Vice-Chancellor end date). The main defect is contamination: six claims about Steven Gunn (historian) sit in her dossier, and several pre-2023 roles (Warden, Warden-elect, Head of Nuffield Department, Pro-Vice-Chancellor) are stated in the present tense despite her documented move to the Vice-Chancellorship in 2023. None of the three listed unjustified conclusions (New England Biolabs, Lancet authorship, sole founder) reappear as dossier claims — the founding claim correctly says 'helped to found'.
